description: Update a milestone — title, description, dates, tags — or change its status (e.g. mark it Completed). Deleting milestones is not available through this connection.

owner.description: Change the milestone Owner — an organization member (email, username, or user id).

status.description: New status: Open (reopen) or Complete — the UI's two milestone states. "Active" and "Completed" are accepted as aliases and normalized to Open/Complete (any other stored value hides the milestone from the UI lists).

name: tm_update_milestone
title: Update Milestone
